benefits.label: Heat Rejection
benefits.detail: Block significant solar heat before it enters the cabin.

benefits.label: UV Protection
benefits.detail: Up to 99% of harmful UV rays blocked — protecting skin and interior.

benefits.label: Glare Reduction
benefits.detail: Reduce eye strain on Kuwait's sun-intense roads.

benefits.label: Comfort
benefits.detail: A cooler, more comfortable drive in every condition.

benefits.label: Privacy
benefits.detail: Controlled visibility — without compromising outward clarity.

technologies.title: Ceramic
technologies.headline: Maximum heat rejection without signal interference.
technologies.desc: LLumar ceramic films use nano-ceramic particles to block up to 99% of UV rays and reject significant solar heat — without affecting mobile or GPS signals.

technologies.title: Metallized
technologies.headline: High performance with a distinctive finish.
technologies.desc: Metallized films use a thin metallic layer to reflect solar energy, delivering strong heat rejection and a sleek, reflective appearance.

technologies.title: Dyed
technologies.headline: Reliable protection at an accessible level.
technologies.desc: Dyed films absorb solar energy to reduce glare and heat. An effective solution for privacy and comfort at a practical price point.

tintLevels.label: Clear
tintLevels.desc: No tint — full light transmission. Maximum visibility, zero protection.

tintLevels.label: Light
tintLevels.desc: 20–35% VLT. Subtle tint with meaningful heat and UV reduction.

tintLevels.label: Medium
tintLevels.desc: 15–20% VLT. Balanced privacy, heat rejection and glare control.

tintLevels.label: Dark
tintLevels.desc: 5% VLT. Maximum privacy and heat rejection for Kuwait's intense sun.

ppf.label: Paint Protection Film
ppf.headline2: Let the Road Take the Impact.
ppf.subline: LLumar PPF is a virtually invisible protective layer that shields your paint from stone chips, scratches and environmental damage.

phases.title: PROTECT
phases.body: Preserve the finish from everyday road exposure.

phases.title: PRESERVE
phases.body: Help maintain the appearance of the paint.

phases.title: PERFORM
phases.body: Advanced film technology engineered for the road.

benefits.title: Self-Healing
benefits.desc: Minor scratches disappear with heat exposure. The film restores itself.

benefits.title: Hydrophobic
benefits.desc: Water beads and rolls off the surface, carrying contaminants with it.

benefits.title: Impact Resistant
benefits.desc: Absorbs road debris, stone chips, and minor impacts before they reach the paint.

benefits.title: UV Stable
benefits.desc: Resists yellowing and maintains optical clarity over years of use.

finishes.label: Gloss
finishes.desc: Crystal-clear protection that enhances your paint's depth and shine.

finishes.label: Matte
finishes.desc: Transforms gloss paint to a premium satin finish while protecting it.

faqs.q: Is window tint legal in Kuwait?
faqs.a: Window tint regulations in Kuwait specify permitted VLT (visible light transmission) levels for different windows. Our team can advise on compliant tint options for your vehicle.

faqs.q: How long does window tint installation take?
faqs.a: A standard automotive tint installation typically takes 2–4 hours depending on the vehicle. We recommend leaving your vehicle with us for the day to ensure a perfect result.
LLumar PPF is designed for long-term durability. With proper care, it can protect your vehicle's paint for many years. Specific warranty terms vary by product.
Yes. Window film can be professionally removed. We recommend professional removal to avoid damage to the glass or adhesive residue.

faqs.q: Do you offer a warranty on installations?
faqs.a: Yes. LLumar films come with manufacturer warranties. Our team can provide specific warranty information for each product.
